data.segment_description:
(Athens: Brian Williams) Report introduced. 
 (Baghdad: Preston Mendenhall) Ongoing anti-coalition resistance in Iraq featured; scenes shown of burning oil facilities in Basra, explosions in Najaf, people injured in an attack on a Najaf police station; details given of the quandary for the Iraqi government in dealing with militant cleric Muqtada al-Sadr. [On the phone, Independent Newspapers Donald McINTYRE†- describes the scene in Najaf.] [Interim Iraqi Prime Minister Iyad ALLAWI {thru translator} – says al-Sadr & his fighters must vacate the holy shrine & engage in political work.] [“Mideast News” editor Adel DARWISH†- comments on how the confrontation is delaying the political process.] 
 (Athens: Brian Williams) Report introduced. 
 (State Department: Andrea Mitchell) The future danger for the US from the standoff with al-Sadr, who may be getting help from Iran, outlined. [Iraq expert Daniel BRUMBERG†- explains that al-Sadr’s legitimacy comes from his family name and the fact that his father was murdered by Iraqi President Saddam Hussein.] [Iraq expert Kenneth KATZMAN†- comments on al-Sadr’s goal to bring down the Iraqi government.] [Middle East expert Shibley TELHAMI†- explains why Shiites are not stopping al-Sadr.] 
 (Athens: Brian Williams) The increase in oil prices {cited} following word of the attack on Iraqi oil facilities, and a report in “The Lancet” claiming that US military doctors collaborated with interrogators in the abuse of prisoners at Abu Ghraib noted.

data.segment_title: Decision 2004 / Bush vs. Kerry / Kerry’s War Record
data.segment_description: (Athens: Brian Williams) Report introduced.   (Derry, New Hampshire: Carl Quintanilla) Senator John Kerry’s defense against political ads attacking his Vietnam war record featured; swiftboatvets.com ad & Kerry campaign ad shown. [In Boston, KERRY – calls for President Bush to denounce the ads from Swift Boat Veterans for Truth; invites Bush to “bring it on” {a debate about service in Vietnam.}] [Former Kerry crewmate Jim RASSMAN††- notes he & Kerry have been hurt by this.] [White House press secretary Scott McCLELLAN – says the president has condemned the ads by the shadowy groups.] [Swift Boat Veterans for Truth John O’NEILL†- says this is a deep & personal part of our lives.]
(Athens: Brian Williams) The results of the first day of trading of Google stock noted; Stock Market Report.
